profile.Name: Halle the Reserved
profile.Job: Diplomat and officer of the Dune Renegades
profile.Personality: Sharp-tongued and sardonic, she mocks small donations and has no patience for cheapness. She is a careful strategist who would dismantle the United Cities piece by piece rather than leave a power vacuum, and she looks down on the Northern Hive as barbarians.
profile.Backstory: She handles outsiders for Jeremiah, the Dune Renegades' leader, at their headquarters in Shraff; he pays her for it, and she corrects him in public when he gets a name wrong. She presents the Renegades as a force against aristocratic rule and slavery, and says they stay friendly with the Northern Hive only out of necessity.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Introduces herself as "Diplomat Halle" and meets bold promises with dry lines like "Yeah. Sure." and "Good luck with that." Snorts, rolls her eyes, and calls the United Cities "the Empire".
